entry.title: Livium CEO on recycling demand “Hockey Stick” - ASX SMIDcaps Conference
entry.summary: Livium Limited CEO & Managing Director Simon Linge talked with Kerry Stevenson from Proactive at the Small and Mid-Cap Conference about the company’s expanding role in battery recycling and its growth outlook within the renewable energy sector. Linge explained that Livium Limited operates across the battery value chain, with its core business focused on lithium-ion battery recycling through its Envirostream division. The company is also expanding into adjacent recycling markets, including solar panels and permanent magnets, driven by client demand and the broader shift toward renewable energy. He highlighted that Livium Limited works with major global clients such as BYD, Hyundai, Volvo Energy and LG Energy Solution, processing end-of-life batteries to recover valuable materials. The company’s business model is already proven, generating revenue through service fees while also sharing in the value of recovered materials. A key theme from the discussion was the strong growth outlook for the sector. Linge noted, “over the next five years, we see a fivefold increase in volumes,” pointing to a significant demand curve driven by energy storage and electric mobility adoption. The company is also progressing a joint venture with Mineral Resources to improve lithium recovery yields in mining, offering additional upside without requiring further capital investment from Livium Limited. entry.title: EU en Australië bereiken handelsakkoord en schaffen veel invoerheffingen af
entry.summary: Australië en de Europese Unie hebben in de nacht van maandag op dinsdag een handelsakkoord gesloten na onderhandelingen van acht jaar. 99 procent van de invoerheffingen op Europese producten zal worden afgeschaft. Bovendien zal er nauwer worden samengewerkt rond defensie.
